name: Fathers Dont Provoke
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of fathers in diligently teaching and guiding their children in the ways of the Lord, as seen in God's commendation of Abraham for commanding his household to do justice and judgment (Genesis 18:19). Fathers are instructed to actively and consistently impart God's truth throughout daily life, ensuring that His works and commands are not forgotten across generations (Deuteronomy 4:9; 6:7; 11:19; Psalms 78:4). Moreover, biblical discipline is presented as an expression of loving care, urging fathers to chasten their sons while there is hope, thus preventing their destruction (Proverbs 19:18).
